mapper.sql: ( SELECT pl.ILAW_ID, MAX(pl.ICATE_NO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_CATE, MAX(pl.SGUBUN_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_GUBUN FROM TB_PROM pl GROUP BY pl.ILAW_ID )

sql.if: AND ( p.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcr.ILAW_ID FROM lcr WHERE lcr.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rr.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rr UNION SELECT ca.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ca START WITH ca.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) CONNECT BY PRIOR ca.ICATE_NO = ca.IREF ) OR lcr.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT gg.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER gg ) ) OR p.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT lca.ILAW_ID FROM lca WHERE lca.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rm WHERE ( ( rm.READER_TY = 'USER' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( rm.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) UNION SELECT cm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE cm START WITH cm.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r2.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r2 WHERE r2.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( r2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( r2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) CONNECT BY PRIOR cm.ICATE_NO = cm.IREF ) OR lca.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT g2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) ) )

mapper.sql: AND p.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcd.ILAW_ID FROM lcd WHERE lcd.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT dd.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE dd START WITH dd.SDEL_YN = 'Y' CONNECT BY PRIOR dd.ICATE_NO = dd.IREF ) )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE hg WHERE hg.CODE_ID = 'SGUBUN' AND hg.CODE = p.SGUBUN_ID AND hg.USE_AT = 'N' )
AND ( p.SNULL_DT IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SNULL_DT) IS NULL OR p.SNULL_DT = '--' OR p.SNULL_DT >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.SGUBUN_ID AS "sgubunId", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'
GROUP BY p.SGUBUN_ID
SELECT SUBSTR(MAX(p.SINS_DT), 1, 16) FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.STITLE AS "title", p.SPROM_DT AS "promDate", c.SNAME AS "cateNm", CASE WHEN p.SSTART_DT > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "pendingYn" FROM TB_PROM p LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO WHERE p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY p.SINS_DT DESC, p.IPROM_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{n}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.STITLE AS "title", p.SPROM_DT AS "promDate", c.SNAME AS "cateNm", CASE WHEN p.SSTART_DT > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "pendingYn" FROM ( SELECT f.ILAW_ID, MIN(NVL(f.ISEEN_LAW_NO, 999999999)) AS SEEN_NO FROM TB_FAVOR f WHERE f.SUSER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY f.ILAW_ID ) fv JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.ILAW_ID = fv.ILAW_ID AND p.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND p.ILAW_NO > fv.SEEN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CATE c ON p.ICATE_NO = c.ICATE_NO WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY p.SPROM_DT DESC, p.IPROM_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{n}
SELECT BBS_ID FROM ( SELECT BBS_ID FROM COMTNBBSMASTER WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' AND BBS_NM = '공지사항' ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ASC, BBS_ID ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM WHERE SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND SEXISTING_YN = 'Y') AS "curProms", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ILAW_ID) FROM TB_PROM) AS "totalLaws", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNQAINFO WHERE ANSWER_CN IS NULL) AS "qnaNoAnswer", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNLOGINLOG WHERE CREAT_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS "todayLogins" FROM DUAL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT w.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.STITLE AS "title", w.SSTATUS AS "status",
w.SUSER_NM AS "userNm", SUBSTR(w.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS "insDt" FROM TB_PROM_WRK w JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO WHERE w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ) AND w.SSTATUS = '승인요청' ORDER BY w.IPWRK_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{n}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w WHERE w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ) AND w.SSTATUS = '승인요청' AND w.SUSER_ID = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT w.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.STITLE AS "title", w.SSTATUS AS "status", w.SUSER_NM AS "actorNm", SUBSTR(w.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS "insDt", w.SREASON AS "reason" FROM TB_PROM_WRK w JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO WHERE w.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(w2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK w2 WHERE w2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ) AND ( ( w.SSTATUS = '승인요청' AND w.SUSER_ID = #{userId} ) OR ( w.SSTATUS IN ('승인반려', '승인완료') AND ( SELECT r.SUSER_ID FROM TB_PROM_WRK r WHERE r.IPWRK_NO = ( SELECT MAX(r2.IPWRK_NO) FROM TB_PROM_WRK r2 WHERE r2.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO AND r2.SSTATUS = '승인요청' ) ) = #{userId} ) ) ORDER BY w.IPWRK_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{n}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT w.IPROM_NO AS "promNo", p.STITLE AS "title", w.SSTATUS AS "status", w.SUSER_NM AS "userNm", SUBSTR(w.SINS_DT, 1, 16) AS "insDt" FROM TB_PROM_WRK w JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = w.IPROM_NO ORDER BY w.IPWRK_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{n}
